basis: Frozen primary histories and exact same-input diagnostic replays; not additional scenarios
findings: No enterprise trajectory in the declared 87-configuration, 24-seed primary campaign has positive complete scenario profit.
No primary trajectory admits or pays for the retained-capability adoption. Investment-date affordability is therefore tested by synthetic controls, not demonstrated in primary histories.
Reference assumptions produce zero enterprise sales. A loses USD154 in setup and recurring overhead. B/C each lose USD515.52 including the declared USD361.52 historical R&D charge.

These results reject financeable improvement inside the particular declared envelope. They do not establish universal nonviability or optimal-policy failure because market friction, value, effort and pricing behavior remain weakly identified.

B/C match exactly because modeled effects, construction/adoption costs, information, policies and semantic random draws are identical; this is a fairness/control result, not empirical identification of full construction efficiency.
reservation_price_identity: p_max = current Alpha posted price + current Alpha modeled utility - max(0, other modeled utilities)

diagnostic_examples.meaning: The modeled buyer would require approximately USD10.47 or less, while Alpha posts USD40. This is a conditional reservation-price calculation, not measured willingness to pay.
The same buyer at a lower price chooses Alpha by roughly USD0.47 of modeled utility; adoption is not structurally forbidden.
Even a zero-priced Alpha offer loses under this buyer's assumed review/integration/trust/error terms. Low provider expense does not guarantee demand.

statistical_limits: Mean intervals use 1.96 times sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(24). They are normal-approximation Monte Carlo intervals conditional on the model, not Student t intervals or confidence intervals for real commercial profitability.
postprimary_policy: Any new assumption-grid exploration must retain all original primary failures and be labeled exploratory. Seed-funded adoption, prospective adoption excluding historical research, and earnings-financed recovery are separate claims. A selected favorable cell does not retrospectively confirm the primary hypothesis.
